text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no, oh no, oh no!!\nWhile I was going 
back and forth between being sick and 
recovering...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I wasn't in time at aaaaall\nto get ready 
for Teio-chan's birthday~...!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, now then, now then~♪ How is 
Tsuru-chan gonna celebrate for me, I 
wonder? I can't wait, I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I prepared a grand present for 
you!?!? Umm... let's see...!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
H-Here! Look, look! This! Is my! Present 
to youuuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's the 'New Teio Step'!! Come 
on, Teio-chan, you try it too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! And at the very end, stick 
out your tongue cutely for the finishing 
pose! Blep!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That felt really good! Let's upgrade 
to this step starting next time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's looking this way! This isn't a 
present, it's a punishment game!
